import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "value": [10.5, 20.3, 15.8, 25.1]
})

# Create an in-memory bytes buffer
buffer = BytesIO()

# Serialize DataFrame to Parquet in the buffer
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to the beginning
buffer.seek(0)

# Deserialize Parquet from buffer into a fresh DataFrame
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

# Verify round trip
print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)
print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.equals(df_restored))
